notes.replace: Replace the six kind TreeViews (`axis.plugins.source|stream|engine|storage|dataset|component`) with one WebviewView `axis.plugins` (`contributes.views.axis[].type: webview`, retainContextWhenHidden true). Keep `axis.workers`. Wiring: window.registerWebviewViewProvider('axis.plugins', provider, { webviewOptions: { retainContextWhenHidden: true } }).
notes.overviewTree: PluginsTreeProvider / registerPluginsTreeView remain exported for unit tests only. Per-kind TreeView classes stay on disk for unit tests. registerPluginKindViews must not createTreeView. registerPluginsAndWorkers must not createTreeView('axis.plugins') — the webview occupies that id.
notes.activationEvents: Add onView:axis.plugins and keep onCommand:axis.plugins.activate. Remove the six onView:axis.plugins.* events once the kind views are dropped from package.json.
notes.assets: Webview loads dist/webview/plugins/main.js + main.css (Vite IIFE, same as results).
